label_policy: CANDIDATE_NEW records a specific surviving delta, not certified novelty; every such item requires independent specialist review.

fixed_point_packages.title: A second-moment bound for gaps between polynomially rough integers
fixed_point_packages.theorem_delta: G_2(X;z) <<_epsilon X(log X)^2 uniformly for X^epsilon <= z <= X^(3/16-epsilon), extending the prescribed-cutoff exponent located in Friedlander's results.
fixed_point_packages.decisive_gate: Verify that Matomaki S1/S2/S3 and well-factorability arguments remain uniform for the modified moving levels; then run exact database search for the 3/16 range.
fixed_point_packages.nonclaim: Not a theorem about prime gaps and does not imply a zeta zero-free strip.

fixed_point_packages.title: Integer and finite-field energies of the length-four cyclic continuant
fixed_point_packages.theorem_delta: R110 gives a coefficient-uniform weighted nonparabolic energy bound H^epsilon(H+H^(3/2)/sqrt(abs(lambda))) times the four L2 masses; R119 is retained only conditionally on a 2026 overlap audit.
fixed_point_packages.novelty_scope: R110 only; the combined package is NOVELTY_UNRESOLVED until comparison with Blomer-Pascadi 2026.
fixed_point_packages.decisive_gate: Proposition-level comparison with Blomer-Pascadi 2026 and sharpness constructions for the H^(3/2) scale.
fixed_point_packages.nonclaim: The energy theorem does not prove the sharp four-cycle bound or a zeta zero-free strip.

fixed_point_packages.title: Small-support Frobenius classes and positive virtual Artin filters
fixed_point_packages.theorem_delta: In a faithful transitive solvable action, the normal closure of elements of support at most ell has orbit size at most 2ell, with sharp constant; applications produce a common split quotient and virtual-character filters.
fixed_point_packages.decisive_gate: Permutation-group search and review for the exact normal-closure/common-block theorem; then audit ramified Artin conductor claims in the applications.
fixed_point_packages.nonclaim: The Artin-filter consequences do not supply the missing field family or a zero-free strip.

fixed_point_packages.title: Sharp sparse positive-cosine antipodes
fixed_point_packages.theorem_delta: Sharp M-atom compression and generic necessity/uniqueness, realization on every prescribed M-harmonic support, and Chebyshev sign classification for consecutive supports.
fixed_point_packages.decisive_gate: Convex-geometry specialist comparison with trigonometric moment-curve facial theory and full-spark interpolation literature.
fixed_point_packages.nonclaim: Does not prove that the prime-log orbit enters a positive chamber.

fixed_point_packages.title: Strict positivity of a fixed-window arithmetic Weil form at a=7/16
fixed_point_packages.theorem_delta: Lean-checked strict positivity for the explicitly defined arithmetic form on the full intrinsic logarithmic form domain, backed by exact certificates.
fixed_point_packages.decisive_gate: Independent frozen-build reproduction and explicit axiom audit.
fixed_point_packages.nonclaim: The Lean theorem is not a formal proof of the corresponding zeta-zero sum identity, RH, or a zero-free strip.

fixed_point_packages.title: Rigidity and flexibility of constrained finite Euler products
fixed_point_packages.theorem_delta: A merged boundary theorem: fixed full-cutoff banks force cofactor zeros, finite Euler cutoffs have dense microscopic a-point clouds, actual later primes give signed local analytic approximation, while positive Chebotarev surgery preserves many coarse statistics but changes the divisor.
fixed_point_packages.decisive_gate: Repair explicit root separation for R161, then compare the merged statement with Helson/Pechersky/universality and random Euler-product literature.
fixed_point_packages.nonclaim: Local shaping and coarse Euler statistics do not control global monodromy or imply a zero-free strip.

fixed_point_packages.title: Localized coercivity and topology no-go results
fixed_point_packages.theorem_delta: Quantitative localized Weil-floor divergence, a singular Hardy boundary anomaly, projection-defect countermodels, and expanding de Branges topology blindness.
fixed_point_packages.decisive_gate: Identify one exact operator-theoretic question and distinguish it from Bondarenko-Radchenko-Seip, Toeplitz index, and pair-of-projections theory.
fixed_point_packages.nonclaim: These semilocal no-go theorems neither prove nor refute RH.

fixed_point_packages.title: Correction to the phase law in Endo's hybrid joint-limit theorem
fixed_point_packages.theorem_delta: A coordinate inversion changes the random Dirichlet-series law, separated from the printed law by a one-prime mixed moment; the marginal/support conclusions can be repaired.
fixed_point_packages.decisive_gate: Private author verification against the current version and coordination of a corrigendum or revision.
fixed_point_packages.nonclaim: This is a correction, not a new universality theorem.

fixed_point_packages.title: Sparse rank-two projective factorization
fixed_point_packages.theorem_delta: Proposed arithmetic classification and counting theorem beyond the verified flattening-minor geometry.
fixed_point_packages.decisive_gate: Prove rational secant/tangent descent, fixed quadratic-field reduction, uniform Pell/fixed-norm counting, three-active-mode reduction, and separation hypotheses.
fixed_point_packages.nonclaim: Finite certificates and minor classification do not prove SR2PF.

self_improvement_rules: Track proof confidence, novelty confidence, and publication readiness separately.
Count canonical theorem statements rather than files, headings, reductions, or descendants.
Merge theorem descendants before assessing novelty.
Treat every changed parameter in an imported theorem as a fresh proof obligation.
Compare with the closest primary result at theorem and exponent level, including recent work.
Require hostile sharpness or boundary examples for quantitative claims.
Do not infer symbolic or asymptotic theorems from finite replay.
Promote only deltas that can be stated without project jargon.
Demote elementary countermodels unless optimal or classificatory.
Re-run the recursive audit only on proof-status, generalization, or literature changes.
Never infer RH, a zero-free strip, or the sharp four-cycle bound from an independent by-product.
